newsitem.title: USA: NetVantage signs $12 mln in business pacts.
newsitem.headline: NetVantage signs $12 mln in business pacts.

text.p: NetVantage Inc, a maker of computer network switching systems, on Monday said it has signed three agreements with original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) that could generate as much as $12 million in revenue over the next 12 months.
One of the OEMs is an existing customer. Two clients are new. One of those is located in the United States, and the other is an international company, NetVantage said.
All three agreements call for the OEMs to purchase a mix of products including the current NV7500 line of Ethernet switches the new NV8500 product line that uses new technology.
